description: Madagascar - Distributed Renewable Energy (DRE) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Geospatial Team (World Bank Group). The Distrubuted Renewable Energy (DRE) Atlas is an open-access interactive web platform providing detailed information on settlements across 58 countries. This platform enables users to easily navigate and obtain essential information about potential mini-grid sites, facilitating informed investment decisions. Its analytics capabilities allow decision-makers to identify key market indicators for investment planning. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 3 files in CSV, GeoJSON, XLSX. The portal files it under Energy access, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2025 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
